description: Redesign genre/[id].jsx and country/[code].jsx category pages to improve visual quality. Fix the ugly hero header in genre page, apply consistent design to country page.
steps: In apps/mobile/src/app/genre/[id].jsx: Redesign the heroHeader section. Remove the current 140px height box with muted primary overlay approach. Replace with a more refined design: reduce height to 100px, use a subtle gradient from a darkened version of colors.primary (e.g., rgba(229,9,20,0.08) blending to transparent), center the genre title with larger typography (fontSize: 32, fontWeight: '800'), position the back button at top-left with proper spacing. Remove heroBackground and heroOverlay views. Use a single clean dark gradient background instead.

In apps/mobile/src/app/country/[code].jsx: Apply a similar refined header design for consistency. The current header is simpler (just a row with back button + title) but lacks visual polish. Add a subtle background treatment similar to the genre page - use a container with a very subtle gradient background (rgba(255,255,255,0.03) at top fading to transparent). Increase the title fontSize to match (use typography.hero or fontSize 28). Add paddingVertical to the header for better spacing.

Verify genre navigation from DetailHero genre pills still works: genre pills call router.push('/genre/{genreId}') which routes to the redesigned genre/[id].jsx page - confirm the useLocalSearchParams still receives 'id' correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Genre page header no longer uses the ugly muted primary overlay
Genre page has a refined, darker gradient header with proper title sizing
Country page header has consistent visual treatment
Back button functions correctly on both pages
Sort/filter TabBar below the header is unaffected and still works
ContentGrid below still receives items and renders correctly
Genre navigation from DetailHero genre pills still routes to correct genre page
findings: Removed unused typography import from both files since the redesigned styles use explicit fontSize/fontWeight values instead of typography.title spreads. Lint passes with 0 errors. Build exports successfully.
